headline.text: L2 FFS fought a bad film roll for *15 hours* — print mark sensor couldn't read, still troubleshooting gussets at window close

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 ran solid production across all four Sollich lines. Matrix 10 on S1 had a cone buildup that caused rejections mid-shift but was cleared by swapping the cone at 17:12. S2 had a brief temper spike at 10:30 that was resolved in 26 minutes. S4 started up with high caramels that weren't wrapping properly; operators dialed in the height by 08:45. One unresolved item: the caramel hopper level sensor on S1 is misreading, possibly due to window light reflection — maintenance and Solich support engaged at window close.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 FFS was down most of the shift wrestling with 5oz York film — every third bag has a line through the print mark and the sensor can't read it consistently. After an overnight fight the line started at 10:53 running 65 ppm, but at 11:55 maintenance was still adjusting gussets and fold. ML2 had a rough start on third shift with a 40-minute PTL safety fault, then recurring film-bunching issues that cost another 40 minutes around 01:00. First shift ran clean after sensor adjustments. ML3 had a brutal blade problem — doubles and triples all night — that required multiple blade replacements, shimming, and belt swaps. Final fix at 11:04 after Fernando replaced all blades and one anvil overnight.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 MF Matrix fought pouch pick-up and weight issues the entire window — suction cups swapped at 17:45 helped briefly, but material bunching returned by 20:03 and weight variance continued into first shift. Still troubleshooting at 11:56. ML1 passed a quiet cleaning day; one note is the almond chain was found rusted out at 11:44. ML4 had a separator belt lose sync at 18:49 (workaround in place) and depositor 1 had a bad buildup at 07:00 that caused a 13-minute stop. Truffle Line had the toughest run: Cavanna belts caused recurring jams and overheating rollers all window. A seized roller was discovered at 05:58 during cleaning and was being addressed at shift change.

notes.text: Midnight Indulgences trial spec sheet in progress; meeting invite next week from Anisa.
Tates White Chocolate ingredient results expected tomorrow; schedule unchanged.
Kirk Nickel flagged: FEA 12g film rolls have off-center cores causing line setup issues.

resolved.title: Chocolate supply ran out at enrober
resolved.summary: Last pallet of 10232 staged at 20:19, expected to run out around 21:00; trailer in yard but not yet dropped.
resolved.resolution: Driver dropped trailer by 21:11; warehouse pulled chocolate to line within 10 minutes.

resolved.title: Matrix 10 packing with low weight, high rejects
resolved.summary: Cone buildup caused one deposit to fall into trailing pouch; high reject rate at checkweigher.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned and re-zeroed MM10, then swapped to spare S1 42 cone at 17:12 — "MM is running much better" (Conner Boyd).

resolved.title: S4 THG not wrapping caramels at startup
resolved.summary: Caramel pieces too high; twist-wrap heads unable to grip and wrap properly.
resolved.resolution: Operators adjusted caramel deposit height; mechanically fine by 08:45, running with occasional high pieces managed (Katya).

resolved.title: S1 temper dropped to 0.9, line paused
resolved.summary: Temper reading low at 08:43, line stopped for adjustment.
resolved.resolution: Temper restored by 09:27; line running with maintenance making adjustments (Katya Farnsworth).

resolved.title: Metal detector on S1 opening randomly with no product
resolved.summary: MD began opening at 09:03 for no apparent reason; no product passing through.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance increased C1 speed to 50; MD issue resolved and "line is in operation" at 09:27 (Ingrid).

resolved.title: S2 bark breaker belt tracking off west side
resolved.summary: Belt tracking off, auto-track bar jammed by a screw in the wrong location.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance moved the screw to correct location; auto-track bar freed and belt tracking properly by 10:12.

resolved.title: S2 line stopped due to high temper
resolved.summary: Enrober temper reading high at 10:30, line halted.
resolved.resolution: Chris J checked for mechanical issues; line running at 10:56 (Katya Farnsworth).

resolved.title: ML3 blades not cutting, doubles and triples
resolved.summary: Accumulator blades producing excessive doubles and triples; shimming ineffective initially.
resolved.resolution: Fernando replaced all four blades, shimmed new ones, replaced one anvil, and replaced accumulator belts overnight; no more doubles at 11:04 after final shim adjustment (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: ML2 PTL safety fault on VFD, line down
resolved.summary: Pre-temper loop safety fault stopped line; third shift start delayed.
resolved.resolution: Raymond popped the fuse from DC bus and reseated it; fault cleared, PTL running at 22:55 (Raymond Fleming).

resolved.title: ML2 film bunching at bobbins, sensor fault
resolved.summary: Film bunching up, print mark not being read; PG11 sensor out of adjustment at 5.4.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance adjusted sensor from 5.4 to 6.9 and corrected print mark reading; line up at 01:46 after ~40 min (Zack Kurtz).

resolved.title: ML2 vacuum system plugged badly
resolved.summary: Mid-shift CIL found vacuum ports plugged; line down to clean vacuum and perform CIL.
resolved.resolution: All ports cleared and cleaned by 16:58; line starting back up at 17:11 (Brandon Lance).

resolved.title: ML3 flow wrap roll change caused brief stoppage
resolved.summary: Line stopped after roll change at 14:31; film didn't break but faults triggered.
resolved.resolution: Faults cleared; line running again at 14:52 (Molding Line 3 Pack).

resolved.title: Truffle Line Cavanna accumulation belt #3 shredded
resolved.summary: Belt #3 shredded; shaft and bearings seized inside roller, replacement roller also bad.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance freed bearings in shop, replaced belt and roller; line running by ~14:22 after cleaning (Rich Brierley).

resolved.title: ML4 depositor 1 bad buildup blocking sensor
resolved.summary: Severe buildup on depositor 1 blocked sensor, hopper didn't fill, line stopped depositing.
resolved.resolution: Buildup cleaned, line restarted at 07:09 after 13 minutes downtime (ML4 WDS Tablet 1).

resolved.title: MF Matrix metal detector container had water particles
resolved.summary: Water particles found inside MD container at 07:02; potential contamination concern.
resolved.resolution: Container emptied and inspected; determined to be residual moisture from third-shift cleaning, not a leak (Ingrid at 08:04).

resolved.title: ML4 TG4 cleaning roller not working correctly
resolved.summary: One roller on TG4 not functioning; Nelson removed to clean and fix.
resolved.resolution: Problem resolved, roller working at 10:53 (ML4 TG).

resolved.title: ML4 gondola jam at entrance (twice)
resolved.summary: Molds jammed at gondola entrance at 07:11, then again at 08:26.
resolved.resolution: Both jams cleared quickly; first in ~1 minute (07:12), second in ~3 minutes (08:29) per Itzel.

needs_attention.title: S1 caramel hopper level sensor misreading
needs_attention.summary: Sensor giving false readings, suspected light reflection from window or sensitivity issue.
needs_attention.status: Attempted blocking light; Chris Jeffs asked to check sensitivity. Justin requested Jorge reach out to Solich for programming support at 11:57.

needs_attention.title: FFS 5oz York film print mark unreadable, line struggling
needs_attention.summary: Every third bag has a line through the print mark; photo eye sensor cannot read consistently, causing stuttering.
needs_attention.status: Fought all night and into first shift. Sensor reading by 07:49, but still working on pleat, tracking, forming, and gussets. Running 65 ppm at 10:53. At 11:55 still adjusting fold or gusset to hold corners.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix pouch pick-up and weight variance ongoing
needs_attention.summary: Pouches not opening properly, missing every 10th or so; weight keeps ejecting bags even at reduced speed.
needs_attention.status: Swapped suction cups at 16:42, helped briefly. Material bunching issue identified at 20:24 ("very difficult to get it to advance without bunching"). Weight problems continued through first shift (07:35, 07:56). Still ejecting bags at speed 38 as of 11:56.

needs_attention.title: Truffle Line Cavanna rollers overheating, causing jams
needs_attention.summary: Infeed belt rollers getting overheated, chocolate accumulating on Cavanna 1 & 2 rails, causing product jams.
needs_attention.status: Multiple cleaning pauses overnight (built 30+ bins twice). Rollers found not spinning at 21:08, fixed temporarily. At 05:58 another drive roller seized and won't spin by hand. Maintenance addressed during cleaning but line struggled all window.

needs_attention.title: ML4 separator belt lost sync, spinning bars
needs_attention.summary: Separator belt lost synchronization, causing bars to spin; divider moved as workaround.
needs_attention.status: Divider repositioned to continue production at 18:49; underlying sync issue not addressed.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix underweight bags found in bin without ID
needs_attention.summary: Second-shift underweight bags discovered in unlabeled bin; no documentation on why they were saved.
needs_attention.status: Charity flagged need to investigate why bags were left without identification. No resolution posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML1 almond chain found rusted out
needs_attention.summary: While searching for master link, discovered old almond chain is rusted through.
needs_attention.status: Discovered at 11:44; no follow-up action posted by window close.
